name: sequence-logo
title: Sequence Logo
description: A sequence logo: stacks of letters sized by information content (bits, with small-sample correction, or relative entropy against a background) or probability, from aligned sequences or a position matrix, in the Nucleotide and Amino Acid hues; a bits axis, a ruler, an IUPAC consensus row of residue tiles, marked stretches, reverse complement, a hover card with every letter's share, and keyboard and pointer range selection; logoCounts, logoColumns, logoConsensus and reverseComplementMatrix helpers.
